title: MoTrans-15: Monetary policy surprises, central bank communication and equity-index responses for the largest economies, 2010-2025 (v2.1.1)
description:
MoTrans-15 (v2.1.1): A comprehensive, replication-certified dataset of monetary policy surprises, central bank communications, macroeconomic controls, and equity-index return responses across the world's largest economies from 2010 through 2025.

Evaluation Window: 2010-01-01 to 2025-12-31 (16 years)
Splits: TRAIN (2010-2021, 572 decisions), VALIDATION (2022-2023, 76 decisions), TEST (2024-2025, 70 decisions)
Embargo Protocol: 60-day embargo prevents multi-horizon event window overlap across split boundaries.

Notice on Access: Access is restricted upon request for academic research and replication due to derived financial return series. The out-of-sample test split is strictly locked and contains zero rate hikes.
notes: MoTrans-15 v2.1.1 release package. The test split (2024-2025) is strictly locked for model selection and out-of-sample evaluation, and contains zero interest rate hikes (property of the 2024-2025 global monetary easing cycle).
